en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a small rural railway station complex. In the foreground are several parallel train tracks and a dirt platform. To the right stands a wooden station building with a gabled roof, chimney, and decorative window frames; a small enclosed porch projects from the façade. To the left is a separate wooden shed or goods building. A few people, including a child, stand near the buildings. Forested countryside fills the distant background. At the top of the image there is printed caption text in Swedish.
